function: Excluded (system): over-the-air federated learning (area 7) over single-antenna links, one scalar fading coefficient h_i per client and no RIS (p. 5, 10).
notes: Excluded, reason system. The work is area 7: it aggregates top-K sparsified model updates by over-the-air computing after a digital voting phase, and tunes the power factors and the denoising factor (pp. 4-5, 8-9), so codes 1 to 5 do not apply. But the link has a single antenna at both ends and no RIS: the client-PS channel is one scalar coefficient (p. 5: "phase 2, hi is the channel coefficient between client"), simulated as i.i.d. Rayleigh (p. 10: "In our simulator, hi is generated from an Gaussian distribution"). No antenna array, beamforming or RIS appears for the paper's own system; the only 'multiple antennas' mention is related work [26] on p. 3. Title and DOI checked on p. 1.
